title: Weighted Derivative Sums of a Gamma Quotient: Sun's Conjecture and Cyclotomic Specializations
summary: Let $f(x) = Γ(x)^2/(2Γ(2x))$ and set $λ_α= 4\sin^2α$ for $0 < α< π/2$. We establish an elementary parameter identity for a weighted translate of $f$ and derive an explicit formula, valid at every derivative order, for the associated weighted sums $\sum_{k\ge1} λ_α^{k-1} f^{(r)}(k)$. The coefficients satisfy an effective recurrence in ordinary zeta values. The unique unweighted specialization $α= π/6$ proves Conjecture 4.1 of Zhi-Wei Sun; at the fourth order a depth-two value $\mathrm{Gl}_{4,1}(π/3)$ occurs.
